authority: Authored EXIT-01 dispositions for non-terminal topics. Every relation is scoped independently; shared evidence does not imply that one result transfers across relation families.

same_mathematics_different_physical_carr.reason: Causal tensor reconstruction and Kramers-Kronig completion transport mathematically, but film growth, domain structure and accessible spectral bands do not.
preservedStructure: Causality, tensor positivity/passivity tests and imaginary-frequency continuation.
lostStructure: Same-batch microstructure, domain and thickness covariance.
implications: Another carrier is a replication, not evidence for a universal material response.
same_mathematics_different_physical_carr.reopeningTrigger: A second material platform with overlapping diagonal/off-diagonal spectra and a frozen causal reconstruction.

same_carrier_different_representation.reason: Transport, ellipsometric and magneto-optic charts can describe one tensor only after conventions, thickness and shared covariance are fixed.
preservedStructure: The physical conductivity tensor and causal spectral measure.
lostStructure: Raw instrument coordinates, extrapolation conventions and energy/current gauges.
implications: Agreement across charts closes OT-006; chart-by-chart fits do not.
same_carrier_different_representation.reopeningTrigger: Held-out cross-channel prediction from a single frozen same-film tensor posterior.

boundary_bulk_defect_topology.reason: Bulk film response is input to a boundary-force calculation, but OT-006 does not determine geometry, patches or domains at the force surface.
preservedStructure: Bulk causal response entering reflection operators.
lostStructure: Boundary roughness, patch map, finite thickness and domain-wall geometry.
implications: Boundary-force claims remain OT-007 even after tensor closure.
boundary_bulk_defect_topology.reopeningTrigger: Measured surface/boundary data sufficient to build the no-refit reflection operator and its covariance.

weak_strong_coupling_and_frequency_limit.reason: The relevant 0.1-1 micrometre Casimir band is about 24-239 THz, while retained Hall data end near 1.5 THz; low-frequency closure cannot be extrapolated freely.
preservedStructure: Low-frequency transport constraints and causal sum-rule bookkeeping.
lostStructure: The off-diagonal tensor over the force-dominating optical band.
implications: No force prediction is admissible until spectral coverage or a bounded tail closes the gap.
weak_strong_coupling_and_frequency_limit.reopeningTrigger: Same-film complex off-diagonal response through the required band or a rigorous causal tail bound narrower than the decision margin.

finite_infinite_size_and_order_of_limits.reason: Coupon spectra do not automatically equal finite-device response when thickness, domains, q dependence and zero-frequency limits compete.
preservedStructure: Measured local tensor within its sample and wave-vector regime.
lostStructure: Uniform control of thickness, lateral size, q to zero and frequency to zero limits.
implications: Half-space or local-response substitutions must be separately bounded.
finite_infinite_size_and_order_of_limits.reopeningTrigger: A finite-geometry response calculation with measured nonlocal/thickness corrections and declared order of limits.

conservation_anomaly_index_and_response_.reason: Causality, Kramers-Kronig consistency, passivity and Onsager/reversal constraints are the invariant checks that make the cross-channel tensor meaningful.
preservedStructure: Causal analytic structure, allowed reciprocity relations and spectral-weight constraints.
lostStructure: They do not fix numerical oscillator strengths or magnetic-domain populations.
implications: Invariant failure vetoes tensor closure; passing invariants does not predict the force by itself.
conservation_anomaly_index_and_response_.reopeningTrigger: A same-film channel violating the frozen invariant ledger outside full calibration covariance.

detector_pushforward_and_information_los.reason: EX-012 explicitly maps raw transport, ellipsometric and magneto-optic records into one tensor and tests held-out channels without force-data refitting.
preservedStructure: Complex tensor components and their shared covariance.
lostStructure: Spectral detail outside bandwidth and spatial variation below probe resolution.
implications: A detector-induced tail or domain ambiguity stops OT-006 before force fabrication.
detector_pushforward_and_information_los.reopeningTrigger: The EX-012 cross-channel detector closure passes its preregistered held-out and covariance gates.

thermodynamic_causal_positive_and_kms_co.reason: The tensor must be causal and passive in the measured state, but equilibrium/KMS use in Lifshitz theory additionally requires controlled temperature, stationarity and material state.
preservedStructure: Equilibrium linear-response analyticity when preparation is stationary.
lostStructure: Nonequilibrium domain kinetics and preparation-history dependence.
implications: A causal fit from a drifting state is not an equilibrium Casimir input.
thermodynamic_causal_positive_and_kms_co.reopeningTrigger: Temperature- and history-stable same-film response satisfying passivity and equilibrium consistency across the required band.

alternative_mechanism_with_same_record.reason: Optical-tail freedom, magnetic domains, thickness variation and cross-channel calibration can reproduce partial tensor records and are explicit EX-012 nulls.
preservedStructure: The observed raw spectra and transport records.
lostStructure: Unique attribution to one bulk causal tensor without shared nuisance closure.
implications: The winning conventional model updates materials knowledge rather than supporting new physics.
alternative_mechanism_with_same_record.reopeningTrigger: A replicated held-out tensor residual outside the complete tail, domain, thickness and calibration model union.

same_mathematics_different_physical_carr.reason: The Lifshitz/reflection calculation transports, but a second force platform has independent separation, patch, roughness and magnetic transfer functions.
preservedStructure: The frozen same-film tensor-to-reflection prediction rule.
implications: Independent apparatus replication is required for a residual.
same_mathematics_different_physical_carr.reopeningTrigger: A second apparatus tests the frozen differential curve with separately calibrated nuisances.

same_carrier_different_representation.reason: Force, force-gradient, resonance-shift and torque records are equivalent only through calibrated mechanical transfer functions and geometry.
preservedStructure: The underlying boundary free-energy derivative for a fixed geometry.
lostStructure: Instrument response, normalization and angular/separation kernels.
implications: Representation conversion may not refit the optical tensor.
same_carrier_different_representation.reopeningTrigger: A calibrated, invertible record-to-force/torque transfer with covariance below the predicted differential.

boundary_bulk_defect_topology.reason: OT-007 is explicitly the bulk-response-to-boundary-force bridge, with orientation and separation interventions distinguishing boundary reflection structure.
preservedStructure: Bulk causal tensor and declared boundary reflection formalism.
lostStructure: Unmeasured patches, roughness, edge effects and domain texture.
implications: Agreement validates a boundary-engineering pipeline, not a universal ontology.
boundary_bulk_defect_topology.reopeningTrigger: EX-012 passes same-film tensor closure and then its blind differential force/torque gate.

weak_strong_coupling_and_frequency_limit.reason: Force at each separation integrates a broad imaginary-frequency range; incomplete spectral coverage makes strong extrapolation indistinguishable from a prediction.
preservedStructure: The frequency-weighted Lifshitz kernel and measured low-frequency constraints.
lostStructure: Unmeasured high-frequency Hall response and zero-mode model choice.
implications: Distance scans diagnose but cannot replace missing spectral input.
weak_strong_coupling_and_frequency_limit.reopeningTrigger: A frozen tensor posterior spanning the force-dominating band with tail uncertainty below the decision threshold.

finite_infinite_size_and_order_of_limits.reason: Plane-plane idealizations, finite resonators, thickness and separation limits need a controlled geometry map before comparison.
preservedStructure: Local reflection response in the regime where proximity/local approximations are bounded.
lostStructure: Edge, curvature, finite-thickness and nonlocal corrections.
implications: A geometry residual cannot be called material or new physics until these limits close.
finite_infinite_size_and_order_of_limits.reopeningTrigger: Certified finite-geometry corrections and a separation range where approximation error is below the predicted signal.

conservation_anomaly_index_and_response_.reason: Causality, reciprocity/reversal and passivity constrain the allowed differential force, but they do not fix its magnitude in the measured geometry.
preservedStructure: Allowed parity/reversal signature and equilibrium analytic constraints.
lostStructure: Material oscillator strengths and surface nuisance amplitudes.
implications: Wrong reversal symmetry vetoes the proposed bridge even if a force is observed.
conservation_anomaly_index_and_response_.reopeningTrigger: A blind force record with the predeclared invariant reversal/distance signature.

detector_pushforward_and_information_los.reason: EX-012 declares the mechanical transfer, blind analysis, dummy spacing scans and raw-to-force covariance needed to distinguish signal from detector drift.
preservedStructure: Differential distance/orientation curve within calibrated bandwidth.
lostStructure: Fast fluctuations, unresolved spatial patches and common-mode force components.
implications: Detector folding defines which boundary distinctions are actually observable.
detector_pushforward_and_information_los.reopeningTrigger: The frozen EX-012 sensitivity calculation resolves the prediction against the complete detector covariance.

thermodynamic_causal_positive_and_kms_co.reason: Equilibrium Casimir prediction requires both material response and apparatus to share a controlled temperature/stationary state; driven or hysteretic domains violate that premise.
preservedStructure: Equilibrium fluctuation-response relation under stationary preparation.
lostStructure: Nonequilibrium population and history-dependent domain forces.
implications: State drift redirects the result to nonequilibrium force modelling, not new physics.
thermodynamic_causal_positive_and_kms_co.reopeningTrigger: Temperature/history reversals demonstrate stationary response and a KMS-compatible frozen prediction.

alternative_mechanism_with_same_record.reason: Patch potentials, roughness, ordinary magnetic force, separation error and optical tails can span a Casimir-like curve and are explicit competing models.
lostStructure: Unique attribution to the tensor-mediated Casimir mechanism.
implications: Only a replicated residual outside the full nuisance union may enter a new-physics lane.
alternative_mechanism_with_same_record.reopeningTrigger: A second apparatus reproduces the frozen distance/orientation residual after independent patch, roughness, magnetic and separation calibration.
